findings.title: Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation via Role ID Assignment in User Registration
findings.trigger: POST /api/auth/register with body { username, password, fullName, roleId: '<adminRoleId>' }
findings.description: Public registration endpoint accepts roleId directly from request body without authentication or validation, allowing any attacker to create an administrative user.
findings.evidence: const { username, password, fullName, phone, roleId } = req.body; ... let finalRoleId = roleId; ... roleId: finalRoleId

findings.title: Plaintext Passwords Stored in AuditLog Details Table
findings.trigger: Admin creating user or updating password on /api/users or /api/users/:id/change-password
findings.description: auditLog middleware serializes the complete req.body into AuditLog details field without redacting password or newPassword, persisting plaintext credentials into database logs.
findings.evidence: details: JSON.stringify({ method: req.method, path: req.path, body: req.body, params: req.params, query: req.query })

findings.title: Operator Role Locked Out of Core Warehouse Menus in Sidebar Navigation
findings.description: Omborxona navigation items (Kirim, Chiqim, Ombor qoldig'i) and Yetkazib beruvchilar are conditioned on isAdmin in layout.js, making them invisible in the sidebar to operators.

findings.title: Stock Overdraw Race Condition in StockOut Transaction
findings.trigger: Concurrent checkout requests for the same product
findings.description: findUnique in Prisma interactive transaction uses standard SELECT without row-locking (no SELECT FOR UPDATE), allowing concurrent requests to read the same stock and overdraw inventory.
findings.evidence: const product = await tx.product.findUnique(...); if (currentStock < quantityDecimal) ... await tx.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { currentStock: newStock } });

findings.title: Negative Current Stock Allowed on StockIn Update
findings.trigger: PUT /api/stock-in/:id with reduced quantity exceeding remaining currentStock
findings.description: updateStockIn calculates newStock = oldStock + quantityDiff without checking if newStock < 0, allowing inventory counts to become negative.
findings.evidence: const newStock = oldStock + quantityDiff; await tx.product.update({ where: { id: product.id }, data: { currentStock: newStock } });

findings.title: Unhandled PrismaClientValidationError and Schema Disclosure via Invalid sortBy
findings.description: Query parameter sortBy is directly interpolated into Prisma orderBy without whitelist validation, triggering PrismaClientValidationError and leaking schema fields in 500 responses.

findings.title: Javascript Syntax Error in Table Delete Handlers on Uzbek Names with Apostrophe
findings.trigger: Clicking delete button for any product, category, or user with an apostrophe (e.g. Bo'yoq, O'tkir)
findings.description: Utils.escapeHtml does not escape single quotes, causing inline onclick handler attributes like deleteProduct('id', 'Bo'yoq') to break with Uncaught SyntaxError.

findings.title: Hardcoded http://localhost:3010/api Breaks Production and LAN Deployments
findings.trigger: Accessing application from IP address, domain, or mobile device
findings.description: API_BASE is hardcoded to http://localhost:3010/api, preventing client requests from working when accessed outside localhost.

findings.title: Unhandled Foreign Key Constraint Crash on Deleting Products and Suppliers with History
findings.trigger: DELETE /api/products/:id or DELETE /api/suppliers/:id for records with stock entries
findings.description: Direct deletion without prior check for related stock transactions causes Prisma P2003 foreign key violation which results in unhandled 500 crash.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on Notification Read Status
findings.description: Endpoint updates notification isRead to true without verifying that the notification belongs to the authenticated user.
findings.evidence: await prisma.notification.update({ where: { id }, data: { isRead: true } });

findings.title: Stub/No-op Implementation of Mark All Read in Layout
findings.trigger: Clicking 'Barchani o'qilgan deb belgilash' in notification menu
findings.description: Function only displays toast notification and does not communicate with backend to mark notifications as read in database.
findings.evidence: async markAllRead() { Toast.info('Barcha bildirishnomalar o\'qildi'); this.loadNotifications(); }

findings.title: Low Stock Warning Notifications Sent Exclusively to Operator Creating Transaction
findings.trigger: Stock drops below minimum during transaction executed by Operator
findings.description: Notification records userId: req.user.id, which routes critical low-stock warnings only to the actor rather than to administrators or as system broadcasts.

findings.title: Missing Validation on Product Update Allows Negative Prices and NaN Crash
findings.trigger: PUT /api/products/:id with non-numeric or negative price fields
findings.description: PUT route only validates product name. Passing non-numeric string results in parseFloat returning NaN, which Prisma rejects with 500 error.

findings.title: Unused MemoryStore Session Middleware Leaking Memory in Production
findings.trigger: Every HTTP request creates an unused session entry
findings.description: express-session MemoryStore is mounted and allocates memory on every request, but no controller uses req.session (app uses JWT).

findings.title: Password Reset via Admin Does Not Invalidate Active User Sessions
findings.trigger: Admin changes compromised user's password via /api/users/:id/change-password
findings.description: Unlike auth.controller.js, user.controller.js does not delete existing sessions when changing password, leaving active sessions alive.
findings.evidence: await prisma.user.update({ where: { id }, data: { password: hashedPassword } }); // no session.deleteMany

findings.title: End Date Filter Truncates Full Day Records in Stock and Reports Queries
findings.trigger: Filtering movements by date range (e.g. 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-08)
findings.description: new Date(endDate) without time component defaults to 00:00:00 UTC, excluding all transactions recorded later that day.
